text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Listen up—all of you.
I have an important announcement to make.

text_block_list.name: L/Roars Member
text_block_list.text: Yes sir!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna lay low for a while.
Won't be seein' you guys for some time."

text_block_list.name: Wolf-Cut Umamusume
text_block_list.text: What's wrong, Pocket-san!?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"That is...
That is, you see—"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Because we're goin' on a hot spring trip startin' tomorrow!
How 'bout that, jealous aren'tcha?!"

text_block_list.name: L/Roars Member
text_block_list.text: You just wanted to brag?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's go, Trainer.
This ain't just an ordinary trip.
It's the ultimate trip to celebrate being the strongest!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: "This ice cream is rock hard, but don't you lose to it either. Punch a hole right through it."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the races winding down for now,
I decided to take Jungle Pocket on the hot spring trip
I won from the raffle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A journey for just the two of us, with no one else around.
Along the way, enjoying our freedom to the absolute fullest—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Man, that bath got me totally hyped up! Seriously the absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Ah, if someone else were here, we could've had a battle royale for the bath towel.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Why? Because I'm strong.
I've never lost to anyone.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right. Hey, partner,
since we've got time, let's watch some TV.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Plus, we might get to see some local stuff
you wouldn't normally catch elsewhere.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what Jungle Pocket wants to watch?
Leaving the choice of channel to her...

text_block_list.name: Comedian
text_block_list.text: "Hey everyone~! We'd like to get started with the three of us today, but..."

text_block_list.name: Comedian
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, where did my partner go!? Sorry to keep
you waiting! Hlllooo, where are you~?"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahahaha!
No way, this comedian is hilarious!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. When you think of TV shows, it's gotta be comedy.
You can instantly have a good laugh anytime.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...Still, hot spring trips really are the best. Doing things you normally can't, seeing things you normally don't—anything goes.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I can be truly free from the bottom of my heart.
Yeah... That's right, I'm...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Honestly, you can be much freer. Without any rules or anything...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I wanna rampage, laugh, and shout to my heart's content.
That's the real me.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Just for right now, I can be myself.
Here, where it's just you and me.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, partner.
Let's come back again, as many dozens of times as we want!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In this secluded, out-of-the-way spot,
Jungle Pocket seemed able to let loose
and be herself to her heart's content.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Now then, if anything goes, I wanna do something way more interesting.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Hold on. Come to think of it, they did mention
this inn has a balcony viewing area.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, partner. Since we're on this trip anyway,
why don't you become my 'real duo partner'?"
choice_data_list: A real partner... What do you mean by that?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
You'll see when we get there.
Alright, follow me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the place Jungle Pocket dragged me to was—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, we're the comedy duo
'Jan-Tre Pocket'!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'm Jungle, and this here's my Trainer.
I'll play the funny man, so nice to meetcha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Out of nowhere, I was dragged out to an unbelievable place.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'll play the fool, so just fire back with the straight line.
Follow my lead!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Having reached this point, I threw caution to the wind.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
You know, just once, I've always thought
it'd be cool to become an Umamusume and join Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"The second exam is an interview, huh...?
What on earth am I supposed to wear...?"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! Gate 1, Car 1, Jungle Pocket,
coming in!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Who the hell are you...?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: See, you can do it when you try!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's go—one more stage.
No—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: At the end of next year, let's go for a double crown: the Arima Kinen and the Comedy Grand Prix!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gradually getting used to playing the straight man.
Their comedy chemistry is just as flawless as their racing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a moment where I felt
an irreplaceable bond with Jungle Pocket...
